decision.summary: Extend the pass-local native-high GF8 AVX2 T=32 maximum-loss regular-kernel policy from R=32 to every punctured R=17..31 for complete 64-byte passes through 512 bytes.
decision.fallback: R<=16, partial loss, translated Algorithm 4, scalar, SSSE3, GF16, forced codecs, and complete passes >=576 bytes retain their previous routes. Ragged calls apply the rule independently to each complete aligned prefix or padded tail pass.
decision.threshold_note: The two weakest 512-byte low-K cells improve by 4.57% and 4.99% against the same-binary control, just below the default 5% point threshold. Promotion is retained because this is one invariant-preserving comparison, all 1,080 directional cells won, the broad 512-byte geometric gain is 13.10%, every exact-main target won by at least 28.82%, and no target or neighbor regressed.

implementation.design: The immutable plan retains exact schedules. Only a qualified byte pass supplies null schedule views to the existing Algorithm 5 executor, selecting its mature regular kernels. padded_side==32 already proves R<=32, so the production predicate uses the single comparison R>16; retaining the redundant upper comparison caused a measured unrelated code-layout regression and was rejected.

authoritative_method.counterbalancing: forward plus reverse role order, with the first role alternating by round
authoritative_method.interval: paired log-ratio Student-t 95% confidence interval, df=8
authoritative_method.ratio_semantics: baseline time divided by current time; values above one favor current Leopard2

directional_scope_search.authority: directional because these screens preceded the clean implementation commit

exhaustive_b64.noisy_cell_disposition: K=170,R=29 reran on nine quiet rounds at 1.60359x, CI95 1.59393..1.61332

target_result_format: Each ratio is [geometric mean, CI95 lower, CI95 upper].

new_gap_found.disposition: Unchanged by this maximum-loss policy and tracked as the next partial-loss optimization task.

correctness_and_safety.release: 8/8 focused backend, locator, dense-plan, direct-oracle high-decode, legacy compatibility, pruned-stage, T32 schedule-policy, and high/low-duality tests passed under a 256 MiB process limit.
correctness_and_safety.asan_ubsan: 3/3 focused direct-oracle high-decode, pruned-stage, and T32 schedule-policy tests passed with Clang 18 ASan+UBSan.
correctness_and_safety.route_matrix: Covers R=17/24/29/31, K=33/57/96/97/224, N=128/256, clustered/striped/random losses, byte sizes 1/63/64/65/511/512/513/575/576/577, unaligned buffers, partial-loss, T16, translated-low, scalar, and existing R32 controls.
correctness_and_safety.initial_sanitizer_build_note: A RelWithDebInfo sanitizer compile exceeded the intentional 512 MiB compiler address-space cap in Clang LiveDebugValues. The Release -O1 -g0 ASan+UBSan build remained capped during compilation and its test executions were intentionally not VA-capped.

invalidated_or_superseded_runs: Authoritative v1 used d84ce20 rather than the immediate Leopard2 parent; exact-main and same-binary measurements were valid, but every cell was rerun with exact parent e3fa363.

Authoritative v2 retained a redundant R<=32 comparison and exposed a >2% inert translated-low one-shot layout regression. The predicate was reduced to the equivalent R>16 form, the regression disappeared, and every cell was rerun as v3.
limitations: Authoritative performance evidence is for one AMD Zen 5 AVX2 host.
Only 30 logical CPUs were available in process affinity, so this single-core campaign cannot supply 128-core or NUMA scaling evidence.
The policy intentionally does not address partial-loss setup/execution; the neighbor campaign identifies that as the next Leopard-main gap.
